Question 5
?

The function P(t)=710ln⁡(1+et) represents the volume of milk, in liters, produced on a farm t days after the owner bought new cows. What is the instantaneous rate of change of the volume of produced milk as a function of t?

a
7101+e−t liters per day
b
710e−t liters per day
c
355et liters per day
d
710et2+e−t liters per day
e
3551+e−t liters per day
